verdicts.title: On the trace of Coxeter elements
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let W be a Weyl group and let w be a Coxeter elememt of minimal length of W. In the early 1970's I.G.Macdonald stated that the trace of w on an irreducible representation of W is 0,1 or -1. In this paper we give a proof of this statement and of an Iwahori-Hecke algebra version of it.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns the trace of Coxeter elements on irreducible representations of Weyl groups (Macdonald's 0, 1, -1 statement), which has no interaction with Tseitin formula resolution lengths or minimal rank bounds.
